name: Legalism
overview: Scripture warns against the empty righteousness of legalism, where outward observance of the law replaces genuine obedience and heart transformation. Jesus challenges His followers to surpass the superficial righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees by embracing the weightier matters of judgment, mercy, and faith rather than merely tithing minor herbs. True discipleship is marked by doing what Christ commands, not just calling Him Lord, and loving Him is demonstrated through keeping His commandments. The focus is on a sincere relationship with God that produces obedient works, not merely human effort to fulfill religious duties.
